notes.title: Your pizzas can be equipped in-game!
notes.content:
[h3]👋Hey everyone![/h3]
In today's update, we've added the function to equip your pizza skins in-game! 

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord server[/url] to receive all the latest updates and help create new pizzas! 🍕

[h3][b]📋CHANGELOG[/b][/h3]
[b]INVENTORY[/b]
◽ Pizzas can be selected as skins
◽ Pizzas can be deleted
◽ Pizzas are now stacked
[b]UI[/b]
◽ Changed pizza counter's format
◽ Changed upgrades format

notes.title: Hotfix 14/07
notes.content: The game should no longer freeze when loading inventory items.

notes.title: 🍕 Three new drops and an in-game inventory 🍕
notes.content:
[h3]👋Hey everyone![/h3]
In today's update, we've finally added the inventory, which can be accessed from the bottom left icon. We removed the 2 limited-time pizzas and [b]added 3 new ones[/b], all designed by our incredible [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord members[/url] [i]Ogujan[/i], [i]BigWorm [/i]and [i]Ionica[/i]! 🍕

[h3]⚠️Important[/h3]
Tomorrow, we'll swap the Steam shop items with new ones, so if you haven't done so, go and get them while you still can!

[h3][b]📋CHANGELOG[/b][/h3]
[b]DROPS[/b]
◽ Added 3 new pizzas
◽ Removed 2 limited-time pizzas

[b]UI[/b]
◽ The inventory of items has been added in-game

notes.title: Patch #1 - New items, upgrades and fixes!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're releasing the first patch for Pizzeria which includes some QoL changes, new upgrades and various fixes. We're also removing the "First Pizza" drop and adding three new items to the drop pool. Expect new updates and items to be released in the coming days!

Remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]join our Discord[/url] for updates, pizza suggestions and special giveaways!

Changelog:

[b]DROPS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Pizza Pedro", "Pizza Vinyl" and "Pizza Low Poly" to the drop pool
[*] Removed "The First Pizza"
[*] Changed the drop rate of the "Pizza" item
[/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two upgrades
[*] Decreased beer event chance of happening
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the way upgrades effects are displayed
[*] Changed upgrades colors
[/list]

notes.title: New trailer released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that the official trailer for [b]Pizzeria[/b] is now live on Steam!

[b]Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062410/Pizzeria/]here[/url]![/b]

Don't forget to:
- [b]Wishlist the game[/b]: show your support and get notified when Pizzeria launches on the 8th of July!
- [b]Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/5CRBkdSaXz]Discord server[/url][/b] for exclusive giveaways and events.

Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to hear what you think about the trailer in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/5CRBkdSaXz]Discord Server[/url]! Thank you for being an amazing community and joining us on this journey.

Happy watching and stay tuned for more updates! 🍕
